answer.reason: The verses tell what happened at Berea: Paul and Silas were sent there, its people received the word, and the Thessalonian Jews stirred up trouble.

clauses.english: was where Paul and Silas were sent by night and preached in the synagogue
clauses.quote: sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea

clauses.english: was where the people received the word readily and searched the scriptures daily
clauses.quote: received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily

clauses.english: was where Jews from Thessalonica came and stirred up the people against Paul
clauses.quote: they came thither also, and stirred up the people

doubts: ACT 20:4 only names Sopater of Berea, so it was left out as it adds nothing beyond the summary.
